review_candidates.description: Job Summary NetApp is seeking a Technical Operations Engineer (OpenSearch) to join our growing Instaclustr team in Bangalore, India. In this role, you will be part of a frontline Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team responsible for ensuring the availability, performance, and reliability of large-scale, cloud-hosted OpenSearch clusters. You will work in a highly automated environment managing distributed open-source systems at scale, collaborating with global customers across industries such as banking, telecom, gaming, and technology. This role requires strong operational expertise, problem-solving skills, and a passion for learning and working with modern cloud-native and open-source technologies. Job Requirements Provide end-to-end operational support for OpenSearch clusters deployed across public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve complex production issues, ensuring high availability and performance. Perform cluster lifecycle operations, including upgrades, migrations, maintenance, and scaling activities. Participate in L2 on-call rotations, ensuring timely incident response and resolution. Collaborate with customer engineering teams to diagnose and resolve issues related to OpenSearch and other supported technologies. Work closely with internal teams to enhance reliability, automation, and operational efficiency. Develop and improve automation tools, scripts, and operational processes. Analyse system behaviour and proactively identify opportunities for performance optimisation and reliability improvements. Contribute to knowledge sharing, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives. Experience with public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Strong Linux system administration skills and comfort with command-line environments. Solid understanding of distributed systems, networking, and OS internals. Experience with containerisation technologies (e.g., Docker). Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to debug complex production issues. Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) with a customer-focused mindset. review_candidates.title: VLSI Functional Safety Hardware Architect
review_candidates.description: Envision Employment Solutions is currently looking for a VLSI Functional Safety Hardware Architect for one of our partners, an IT Services and IT Consulting company. THE ROLE In automotive silicon, a missed fault isn't a bug report, it's a safety risk. You'll define and build the safety mechanisms inside complex ASICs and SoCs, turning ISO 26262 requirements into RTL that is traceable, verifiable and ready for certification. You'll be the bridge between the functional safety team and the designers who build the chip. WHAT YOU'LL DO Contribute to SoC architecture definition, subsystem design and RTL microarchitecture Design and integrate functional safety mechanisms at RTL and SoC level in line with ISO 26262 and target ASIL levels Translate safety requirements into RTL and keep traceability through implementation and verification Configure, integrate and customise internal, third party and black box IPs Create and maintain IP level documentation covering safety requirements, mechanisms, diagnostics, assumptions and integration constraints Support fault analysis, safety reviews and functional safety work products throughout the lifecycle Collaborate with safety, verification, design and system teams, and consider SoC to PCB level interactions WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 10+ years of experience in ASIC and/or SoC development Strong hands on RTL design in Verilog and SystemVerilog Practical experience applying ISO 26262 and ASIL requirements in semiconductor development Experience implementing and documenting safety mechanisms such as redundancy, fault detection and safety monitoring Solid experience with IP integration, configuration and customisation Knowledge of ARM and/or RISC-V, AXI and NoC interconnects Understanding of hardware and software interaction and board level considerations Strong communication and stakeholder management skills YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU You think about how a design fails as carefully as how it works You write documentation that an assessor and an integrator can both use You're comfortable owning the safety story of an IP end to end You enjoy working at the point where architecture meets RTL You want your work to go into products people trust with their lives
